newsitem.title: USA: Holder names nominee for Telephone board.
newsitem.headline: Holder names nominee for Telephone board.

text.p: Franklin Mutual Advisers Inc, a unit of Franklin Resources said Wednesday it intends to nominate Martin Solomon as a "Class 1" director on Telephone and Data Systems Inc's board.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, FMAI said Solomon is former Great Dane Holdings Inc vice chairman and currently a director at XTRA Corp, Hexcel Corp and DLB Oil & Gas Inc.
FMAI intends to place Solomon's name in nomination at the next annual meeting of the Chicago-based company which is engaged in the operation of telephone, cellular and radio paging systems.
Franklin has a 9.8 percent stake in Telephone or 5,308,600 series A common shares which were purchased for investment purposes, the company disclosed in its Feb 25 filing.
